title: viola arenaria subsp. puberula
intro: Viola arenaria subsp. puberula, commonly known as the woolly violet, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the violet family (Violaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Viola arenaria subsp. puberula include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antitumor activities.
